mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over 6 months signals accommodative policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% triggers monetary tightening, raising interest rates and pressuring equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5%, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor) signals robust consumption and job growth, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up 5% and PAYEMS up 2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not statistically significant (p>0.05) despite the proxy interaction.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 exceeding 5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate further economic gains.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive in late-cycle expansion periods (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in INDPRO (supply) and GDPC1 (demand) indicate improved production and consumption, fostering economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO up 2% and GDPC1 up 3% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not statistically significant despite the proxy interaction.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 3% signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE falling below 3%, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Continuous upward trend in PAYEMS (labor) over 6 months reflects robust job growth, supporting economic expansion and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite sustained job growth in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (e.g., INDPRO below 102.5), persistent declines in production may lead to deflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain positive despite INDPRO below 102.5, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.
